pages.quiz:
HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #15
====

GRADE: PP1
SUBJECT: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Myself? (1 mark)
   A. Use Myself to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Myself has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Myself.
   D. Apply the teaching of Myself with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

2. Which response best shows understanding of Names of Scriptures? (1 mark)
   A. Use Names of Scriptures to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Names of Scriptures has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of Names of Scriptures with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Names of Scriptures.

3. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Waste food daily
   B. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   C. Destroy trees without planting
   D. Pollute rivers deliberately

4. Which response best shows understanding of General Etiquette? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing General Etiquette.
   B. Say General Etiquette has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of General Etiquette with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use General Etiquette to insult classmates of other faiths.

5. Which response best shows understanding of The Enlightened Beings? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Enlightened Beings.
   B. Apply the teaching of The Enlightened Beings with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say The Enlightened Beings has no place in daily life.
   D. Use The Enlightened Beings to insult classmates of other faiths.

6. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Hiding stolen items
   B. Cheating in exams
   C. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   D. Spreading rumours

7. Which response best shows understanding of Simple postures? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Simple postures.
   B. Say Simple postures has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of Simple postures with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Simple postures to insult classmates of other faiths.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Places of Worship? (1 mark)
   A. Use Places of Worship to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Places of Worship has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Places of Worship.
   D. Apply the teaching of Places of Worship with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

9. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   B. Skipping all moral lessons
   C. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   D. Refusing to help a neighbour

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
10. In three clear sentences, explain Simple postures and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

11. In three clear sentences, explain General Etiquette and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

12. In three clear sentences, explain Myself and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

13. In three clear sentences, explain Places of Worship and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:

====

3. B — Care for the environment and use resources wisely

4. C — Apply the teaching of General Etiquette with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

5. B — Apply the teaching of The Enlightened Beings with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

6. C — Telling the truth and keeping trust

7. C — Apply the teaching of Simple postures with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

8. D — Apply the teaching of Places of Worship with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

9. C — Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
